messages:
nora-sales: Monarch Bank wants BYO-KMS POC. Requirements: automated 90-day rotation demo, 48h pen-test window, perf target 9k QPS (p95 <140ms), and clear pricing (onboarding vs runtime). Can we confirm?
kevin-se: We can run the demo if their KEK stays in their HSM and they provide wrapped test keys + thumbprint. Need traffic profile (seq len).
anya-crypto: Security constraints: never accept plaintext KEK, require thumbprint verification (sha256 hex), signed nonce handshake for rotation, and HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2/3).
zoe-legal: I'll add SOW clauses: "no plaintext key export", rotation rollback playbook, audit-log retention (1y), pen-test limited liability (cap=1x monthly SLA credit).
matt-eng-ops: Perf slot available Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC. We'll need allowlist: 52.24.33.7/32 and 52.24.33.8/32 port 443. Preflight curl: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.redwood.example.com/healthz`
finance-bot: Proposed pricing: onboarding $12k one-time OR waive for enterprise; runtime connector $110/hr during POC + $0.6/request above baseline. Finance to confirm.
nora-sales: Action items: 1) I'll request wrapped keys and allowlist from Monarch, 2) Kevin to draft perf checklist, 3) Anya to publish rotation handshake spec, 4) Zoe to drop SOW snippets, 5) Matt to reserve perf slot. Will send combined pack to Monarch by EOD.
